name: Carparts of Pepperell
old_description: Carparts Distribution Center is a locally owned and operated automotive parts supplier that has been service the automotive industry since 1975 and many of our employees have been working in the industry for over 40 years.
about:
Carparts Distribution Center, operating as Carparts of Pepperell among other locations, traces its roots to 1975 when it began as a locally owned automotive parts supplier in southern New Hampshire. The company maintains its corporate offices in Plaistow, New Hampshire, while the Pepperell, Massachusetts location at 166 Main Street serves as one of 21 retail and commercial outlets spread across New Hampshire, Massachusetts, and Maine. Ownership has remained local and private since founding, though the original founders are not named in public records.

The business functions as a full-line automotive parts distributor, stocking replacement components for passenger cars, light trucks, and heavy-duty applications through its Auto Value affiliation. Its network includes 21 storefronts — branded variously as Carparts of [Town], Motor Supply (a division with eight Maine locations), and Steve's Auto Parts — supported by a central distribution center. Each site carries inventory for immediate counter sale and runs commercial delivery routes for professional repair shops, with express and courier options advertised for urgent needs.

Primary customers are independent repair shops, fleet maintenance operations, and do-it-yourself vehicle owners throughout northern New England. The Motor Supply division specifically targets heavy-duty and commercial truck repair in central Maine, while the Carparts-branded locations serve the broader light-vehicle aftermarket across the three-state footprint.

The company positions its longevity and service model as its differentiator, emphasizing that many staff members have spent four decades in the industry. Its internal motto, "SERVICE IS THE DIFFERENCE," reflects a strategy built on in-person counter expertise and rapid local delivery rather than catalog breadth alone.
